about: Reasons a live run may produce nothing and still be a correct run, graded IDLE (sub = the stated token) when its own receipt STATES the reason (empty_reason / skip_reason / no_op_reason, top level or summary). Read by scripts/lib/run_quality.py. LQ-20261107-1842: IDLE is its own grade — not GOOD (nothing was produced), not EMPTY (nothing is wrong), never green. A zero-output run with no stated reason, or a reason not listed here, stays EMPTY. An idle run with a stale or implausible input is DEGRADED. Every token below was observed in a real lane receipt (2026-11-10 scan of data/runtime/*_last.json plus the audit-revalidation evidence rows); none is invented. deferred_to_batch, credit_cap_reached, data_blocked and dependency_unavailable are deliberately not idle: they name work that could not be done, not work there was none of.

reasons.not_trading_day: it was not a trading day
reasons.window_not_reached: its window had not opened yet
reasons.all_duplicate: every candidate had already been ingested
reasons.no_due_threads: no thread was due for a check
reasons.no_outcomes_written: there were no outcomes to write
reasons.below_trigger: the pressure was below its trigger
reasons.no pending proposal needed an alert this: no pending proposal needed an alert
